F1M24 MOD MANAGER __VERSION__
=============================

HOW TO INSTALL
--------------
1. Extract this archive.
2. Run "F1M24 Mod Manager___VERSION___x64-setup.exe".
3. Windows will ask for Administrator rights: the manager writes mods into
   the game folder, which normally lives under Program Files.


"WINDOWS PROTECTED YOUR PC"
--------------------------
The installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns that the
publisher is unknown. Click "More info" and then "Run anyway".

Some antivirus engines may also flag it heuristically. This is a known
false positive for new, unsigned installers that request Administrator
rights. The app is open source and every release is built automatically
from the public source code, so you can verify exactly what it does:

  Source code:  https://github.com/aleex0428/f1m24-mod-manager
  Releases:     https://github.com/aleex0428/f1m24-mod-manager/releases

Downloading from the GitHub releases page above is always the most
up-to-date option, and the app updates itself from there.


WHAT IT DOES
------------
- Browse and search the Overtake.gg catalog for F1 Manager 2024
- One-click install: downloads, unpacks and copies the .pak files
- Enable/disable mods without deleting them, drag to set load order
- Warns when two active mods claim the same pakchunk
- Launches the game

Not affiliated with Overtake.gg, Frontier Developments or Formula 1.
All mods belong to their respective authors.
